title: Evaluating Trust in AI, Human, and Co-produced Feedback Among Undergraduate Students

bias_targets.methodology: A within-subject experiment comparing undergraduate students' ratings of feedback (assessing usefulness, objectivity, genuineness, and credibility) before and after revealing whether the source of the feedback was an AI, a human teaching assistant, or human-AI co-produced. The study measures systematic shifts in perception based solely on the disclosure of the provider's identity.
